sampling.random: SRS without replacement in the frozen eligible-page frame of purposively selected documents. Conditional inclusion probability n/N is recorded per anchor. No corpus-wide estimate.
sampling.stress: One heuristic anchor per selected family, plus available adjacent pages; actual structure labels remain unknown until independent annotation.
sampling.overlap: One page job per source/page, multiple memberships allowed. Never add overlapping memberships as independent pages.
sampling.family: Exact SHA aliases, protocol/SAP study pairs, regulatory dossier variants and same-product large-raster links grouped. Native duplicate/near-page candidates excluded from development comparisons; this is not exhaustive visual deduplication.
sampling.reserve: Record-clean reserve excludes detected duplicate pages connected to any prior-exposure document, including through intermediate copies.
sampling.context: Context pages support relationships. Random anchors, stress anchors and whole-document workflow results are reported separately. Context-only pages do not enlarge random sample denominator.

annotation.pending: objects=null and negative_page=null; missing annotations are not empty ground truth.
annotation.review: Agent drafts cannot be called human Gold. Source inspection must precede inference output inspection. Record reviewer type and time.
annotation.hierarchy: Figure -> main panel -> inset; legend block -> legend title/items. Shared legend may associate with multiple panels.
annotation.tables: Cell literals plus zero-based row/column and spans, header/unit/footnote ownership. Redacted or unreadable content remains untranscribed.
annotation.cross_page: Global object IDs permit previous-page captions and table continuation ownership within the same source document. Source/parent cycles are invalid.

metrics.object_detection: Within same SHA and page, one-to-one same-kind bbox matching at IoU>=0.5. Report logical Figure/Table and panel/inset separately. Never substitute physical region count for semantic object count.
metrics.literal_fields: Normalize Unicode NFKC and whitespace; preserve digits, units and substantive punctuation. Count all annotated readable fields, including fields absent from model candidates. Report exact transcription precision/recall separately from localization and ownership.
metrics.roles: Score candidate roles against annotations separately from automatically accepted roles. Heading vs legend entry is a role error even when characters match. Unknown/needs-review role is an abstention, not a correct role.
metrics.associations: Require correct parent/panel or shared-panel set. Text present elsewhere on page is not sufficient ownership evidence.
metrics.tables: Report literal-cell accuracy and header/unit/footnote association accuracy separately; selected numeric spot checks do not certify entire tables.
metrics.undefined: Zero denominator yields null, not 100%. Pending/unreadable/ambiguous labels are reported separately with explicit coverage.
metrics.uncertainty: Report numerator/denominator, subgroup and document/family counts. Do not assume fields within one document are independent observations.
metrics.retrieval: Questions must be frozen before outputs are examined. Use common multi-document corpus with distractors, and report Korean/English separately. No answer accuracy claim until answer-layer evidence rules are connected.
metrics.cost: Record elapsed time, page/figure OCR and VLM requests, internal forwards when observable, failures/retries/budget abstention, CPU/GPU memory.

deployment_gate.note: Provisional development target only. Independent visual labels, recall/abstention coverage and resource budgets must be established and acceptance criteria frozen before final test.
